notes.title: Nominate me!
notes.content:
Too many great indie games fall through the cracks and are never seen. But you can help to change this!

Daydream is a solo passion project of 10+ years that has been described as a hidden gem! It's thousands and thousands of hours of passionate work and it's not over. New features and updates keep coming in!

For the love of classic JRPGs and for the love of indie developers, nominate Daydream during the Autumn Steam Awards and give it the visibility it deserves!

Your friendly neighbourhood developer,
Caroline
